interface.longDescription: Creative Educator is an Education & Research plugin for medical and health-professions educators. It turns learning objectives, blueprints, source documents and teaching goals into aligned lesson plans, courses, self-study modules, active-learning activities, assessment plans, rubrics, simulated grand rounds, presentation storyboards and faculty-development materials. It supports constructive alignment, adaptive learning, educational evaluation and critical review of teaching materials. For presentation work it uses a concise slide-design workflow and can create a PowerPoint when artifact tools are available; otherwise it produces a production-ready storyboard. It is designed to work alongside curriculum-blueprint, tutoring and exam-practice workflows without duplicating their roles. It supports Vietnamese and English, verifies current education guidance when needed, and includes an Update by Bing workflow for live web refresh. It does not provide patient-specific diagnosis or treatment, process identifiable patient records, or claim institutional endorsement.
